preferences are hidden unless asked for.

Article-type profile (S4). `auto` guesses from the headings and is
otherwise `general`; the others switch off the checks that do not
apply to that kind of document and say what section unheaded prose is
in (a commentary is argued like a Discussion).

ErrorBody.description:
Every non-2xx response. `code` is stable and machine-readable;
`message` is for people and never contains document text.

code.description: One of: invalid_request, malformed_json, malformed_request, payload_too_large, unsupported_media_type, unsupported_file, unreadable_file, unauthorized, sign_in_required, auth_unavailable, rate_limited, not_found, method_not_allowed, internal, or http_error for any other HTTP status

to /v1/analyze-file instead; `word_paragraphs` arrives with the hosted
add-in (S3).
Format.title: Format

status.description: degraded when any tier the service is configured to run is not ok.
status.title: Status

reading.description: flat | hedged | assertive | balanced | heavily hedged
